question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The long march through the desert heat began to enervate even the fittest soldiers.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Exhaust.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Enervate" means to weaken or drain someone of energy and vitality. Its closest synonym is "Exhaust". (कमजोर कर देना, शक्तिहीन कर देना)
◦ Correct: The long march through the desert heat began to enervate (exhaust) even the fittest soldiers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2 "Invigorate" (to energize), Option 3 "Strengthen" (to make strong) and Option 4 "Motivate" (to inspire action) are unrelated to draining someone's strength and energy.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of enervate: exhaust, weaken, debilitate, sap, tire, drain. Antonyms: invigorate, strengthen, energize, fortify.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Garrulous (बातूनी): Talkative (बातूनी), Chatty (गपशप करने वाला), Loquacious (वाचाल), Voluble (वाक्पटु)

 

2. Hapless (अभागा): Unlucky (दुर्भाग्यशाली), Unfortunate (अभागा), Luckless (भाग्यहीन), Ill-fated (दुर्दैवी)

 

3. Impetuous (उतावला): Impulsive (आवेगी), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Hasty (उतावला), Reckless (लापरवाह)

 

4. Jubilant (आनंदित): Elated (उल्लसित), Overjoyed (अत्यंत प्रसन्न), Ecstatic (आनंदविभोर), Delighted (प्रसन्न)

 

5. Knavery (धूर्तता): Trickery (छल), Deceit (धोखा), Dishonesty (बेईमानी), Roguery (बदमाशी)

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Chronic
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Persistent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Chronic" means lasting for a long time or constantly recurring, especially of an illness or problem. Its closest synonym among the options is "Persistent" (continuing over a long time without stopping). (दीर्घकालीन, लम्बे समय से चल रहा)
◦ Example: The patient has been suffering from a chronic (persistent) back pain for over a decade.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Temporary" means lasting for only a limited time — the opposite of chronic, which persists for a long time.

 

• Option 3 "Occasional" means happening now and then, not regularly — unlike chronic, which is constant and ongoing.

 

• Option 4 "Curable" means capable of being healed or fixed — chronic conditions are typically long-lasting and often not easily cured.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of chronic: persistent, continuing, long-lasting, lingering, incessant, deep-rooted. Antonyms: temporary, occasional, acute, brief.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Languish (क्षीण होना): Wither (मुरझाना), Weaken (कमजोर होना), Decline (पतन होना), Fade (फीका पड़ना)

 

2. Meticulous (सावधानीपूर्ण): Careful (सावधान), Precise (सटीक), Thorough (पूर्ण), Painstaking (श्रमसाध्य)

 

3. Nefarious (अधम, दुष्ट): Wicked (दुष्ट), Evil (बुरा), Villainous (खलनायक जैसा), Sinister (अशुभ)

 

4. Opulent (समृद्ध, वैभवशाली): Lavish (आडंबरपूर्ण), Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Sumptuous (भव्य), Affluent (धनी)

 

5. Placate (शांत करना): Appease (संतुष्ट करना), Pacify (शांत करना), Soothe (सुकून देना), Conciliate (मेल कराना)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

His reckless driving on the wet highway caused a serious accident.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Rash.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Reckless" means acting without thinking about the consequences, showing a lack of care for danger. Its closest synonym is "Rash". (लापरवाह / उतावला)
◦ Correct: His reckless (rash) driving on the wet highway caused a serious accident.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Cautious" (careful), Option 2 "Careful" (attentive to safety) and Option 4 "Prudent" (wise and careful) are unrelated to acting carelessly without regard for danger.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of reckless: rash, careless, hasty, foolhardy, imprudent, heedless. Antonyms: cautious, careful, prudent, wary.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Quandary (उलझन): Dilemma (दुविधा), Predicament (कठिन स्थिति), Puzzle (पहेली), Impasse (गतिरोध)

 

2. Rancor (द्वेष): Resentment (आक्रोश), Bitterness (कड़वाहट), Hostility (शत्रुता), Animosity (वैमनस्य)

 

3. Squander (बर्बाद करना): Waste (बर्बाद करना), Misspend (गलत खर्च करना), Dissipate (उड़ा देना), Fritter (व्यर्थ गंवाना)

 

4. Taciturn (मितभाषी): Reserved (संकोची), Reticent (मौन रहने वाला), Silent (चुप), Uncommunicative (अल्पभाषी)

 

5. Unscrupulous (बेईमान): Dishonest (बेईमान), Unethical (अनैतिक), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Deceitful (छलपूर्ण)

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Diligent
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Hardworking.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Diligent" means showing careful and persistent effort in one's work or duties. Its closest synonym among the options is "Hardworking" (putting in consistent, earnest effort). (मेहनती, लगन से कार्य करने वाला)
◦ Example: The diligent (hardworking) student reviewed her notes every single evening before the exam.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Lazy" means unwilling to work or make an effort — the direct opposite of diligent, who works with dedication.

 

• Option 2 "Careless" means not paying attention to detail or consequences — unlike diligent, which implies great care in one's work.

 

• Option 3 "Indifferent" means showing no interest or concern — the opposite of diligent, who is devoted and attentive to the task.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of diligent: hardworking, industrious, assiduous, conscientious, sedulous, painstaking. Antonyms: lazy, careless, negligent, indifferent.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Vindicate (निर्दोष सिद्ध करना): Justify (उचित ठहराना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Absolve (बरी करना), Clear (निर्दोष घोषित करना)

 

2. Whimsical (सनकी): Fanciful (कल्पनाशील), Capricious (चंचल), Quirky (विचित्र), Playful (चंचल स्वभाव का)

 

3. Zealous (उत्साही): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Ardent (उत्कट), Fervent (जोशीला), Passionate (जुनूनी)

 

4. Abhor (घृणा करना): Detest (नफरत करना), Loathe (घृणा करना), Despise (तिरस्कार करना), Hate (नफरत करना)

 

5. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Kind (दयालु), Charitable (उदार), Generous (उदारशील), Compassionate (करुणामय)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The constant delays in the project began to exasperate the entire team.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Annoy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Exasperate" means to irritate or provoke someone intensely, especially through repeated actions. Its closest synonym is "Annoy". (चिड़ाना, क्रोधित करना)
◦ Correct: The constant delays in the project began to exasperate (annoy) the entire team.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2 "Please" (to make happy), Option 3 "Calm" (to soothe) and Option 4 "Comfort" (to console) are unrelated to provoking irritation or anger in someone.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of exasperate: annoy, irritate, infuriate, provoke, incense, vex. Antonyms: please, calm, soothe, comfort.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Candor (स्पष्टवादिता): Frankness (स्पष्टता), Honesty (ईमानदारी), Openness (खुलापन), Sincerity (निष्कपटता)

 

2. Despondent (निराश): Dejected (उदास), Hopeless (निराश), Downcast (मायूस), Disheartened (हतोत्साहित)

 

3. Emulate (अनुकरण करना): Imitate (नकल करना), Mimic (अनुकरण करना), Copy (नकल करना), Replicate (प्रतिकृति बनाना)

 

4. Fastidious (नुक्ताचीनी करने वाला): Meticulous (सावधान), Particular (चूज़ी), Finicky (नखरैल), Fussy (झक्की)

 

5. Gullible (भोला, आसानी से धोखा खाने वाला): Credulous (भोला), Naive (अनुभवहीन), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला), Unsuspecting (अनजान)

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Vigilant
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Alert.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Vigilant" means keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulty. Its closest synonym among the options is "Alert" (watchful and quick to notice things). (सतर्क, चौकस)
◦ Example: The guards remained vigilant (alert) throughout the night, watching every entrance closely.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Careless" means not giving enough attention to avoiding mistakes or danger — the opposite of vigilant, which implies constant attentiveness.

 

• Option 3 "Sleepy" means feeling drowsy or ready to fall asleep — the opposite state of a vigilant person, who stays awake and watchful.

 

• Option 4 "Negligent" means failing to take proper care over something — the direct opposite of vigilant, which means being watchfully cautious.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of vigilant: alert, watchful, attentive, wary, observant, circumspect. Antonyms: careless, negligent, inattentive, heedless.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Harbinger (अग्रदूत): Herald (संदेशवाहक), Forerunner (अग्रदूत), Precursor (पूर्ववर्ती), Omen (शगुन)

 

2. Indolent (आलसी): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय), Slothful (सुस्त), Lethargic (आलस्यपूर्ण)

 

3. Jocular (हंसमुख, विनोदी): Humorous (हास्यप्रद), Playful (चंचल), Witty (वाक्पटु), Jovial (प्रफुल्लित)

 

4. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Coherent (तर्कसंगत), Transparent (पारदर्शी), Intelligible (समझने योग्य)

 

5. Malign (बदनाम करना): Slander (निंदा करना), Defame (बदनाम करना), Vilify (अपमानित करना), Denigrate (अपमानित करना)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The obsequious clerk agreed with everything his boss said, hoping for a promotion.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Submissive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obsequious" means excessively eager to please or obey someone, often in a servile manner. Its closest synonym is "Submissive". (चापलूस, खुशामद करने वाला)
◦ Correct: The obsequious (submissive) clerk agreed with everything his boss said, hoping for a promotion.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Arrogant" (proud and overbearing), Option 2 "Independent" (self-reliant) and Option 4 "Rebellious" (defiant) are unrelated to excessive eagerness to please and flatter someone.

 

NOTE

 

• "Obsequious" is most often met in the phrase "obsequious flattery" — excessive, fawning praise meant to win favor. Synonyms: submissive, servile, sycophantic, fawning, deferential. Antonyms: arrogant, domineering, defiant, assertive.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Nadir (निम्नतम बिंदु): Lowest point (सबसे निचला बिंदु), Bottom (तल), Depth (गहराई), Rock bottom (सबसे बुरी स्थिति)

 

2. Ostentatious (दिखावटी): Showy (भड़कीला), Flashy (चमकदार), Pretentious (आडंबरपूर्ण), Flamboyant (भड़कीला)

 

3. Paucity (कमी, अभाव): Scarcity (अभाव), Shortage (कमी), Dearth (टोटा), Insufficiency (अपर्याप्तता)

 

4. Querulous (शिकायती): Complaining (शिकायती), Whiny (रोनेवाला), Peevish (चिड़चिड़ा), Grumbling (बड़बड़ाने वाला)

 

5. Repudiate (अस्वीकार करना): Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Disown (त्यागना), Renounce (त्याग देना), Deny (इनकार करना)

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Pinnacle
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Peak.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pinnacle" means the highest point or stage of success or achievement. Its closest synonym among the options is "Peak" (the highest point of something). (शिखर, चरम बिंदु)
◦ Example: Winning the world championship marked the pinnacle (peak) of her athletic career.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Bottom" means the lowest point of something — the opposite of pinnacle, which represents the highest point.

 

• Option 2 "Failure" means lack of success in achieving something — the opposite of pinnacle, which denotes the height of success.

 

• Option 3 "Decline" means a gradual fall or deterioration — the reverse of pinnacle, which marks the peak, not the fall.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of pinnacle: peak, summit, apex, zenith, climax, crest. Antonyms: bottom, nadir, base, decline.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Solace (सांत्वना): Comfort (आराम), Consolation (सांत्वना), Relief (राहत), Succor (सहायता)

 

2. Tenacious (दृढ़): Persistent (दृढ़), Determined (दृढ़ निश्चयी), Resolute (अटल), Stubborn (हठी)

 

3. Umbrage (नाराज़गी): Offense (अपमान), Resentment (आक्रोश), Displeasure (नाराज़गी), Annoyance (खीज)

 

4. Venerate (आदर करना): Revere (श्रद्धा करना), Respect (सम्मान करना), Honor (सम्मानित करना), Worship (पूजना)

 

5. Wary (सतर्क): Cautious (सावधान), Careful (सतर्क), Guarded (सतर्क रहने वाला), Watchful (चौकस)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The cacophony of car horns and shouting vendors filled the crowded street.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Discord.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Cacophony" means a harsh, jarring mixture of discordant sounds. Its closest synonym is "Discord". (कर्कश आवाज़ / शोरशराबा)
◦ Correct: The cacophony (discord) of car horns and shouting vendors filled the crowded street.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2 "Harmony" (pleasant agreement of sounds), Option 3 "Silence" (absence of sound) and Option 4 "Melody" (a pleasing sequence of musical notes) are unrelated to a harsh, jarring mixture of noise.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of cacophony: discord, dissonance, din, racket, clamor, clatter. Antonyms: harmony, melody, euphony, silence.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Adroit (निपुण): Skillful (कुशल), Dexterous (निपुण), Proficient (दक्ष), Clever (चतुर)

 

2. Bemoan (विलाप करना): Lament (शोक करना), Deplore (खेद प्रकट करना), Mourn (शोक मनाना), Bewail (विलाप करना)

 

3. Coerce (मजबूर करना): Compel (बाध्य करना), Force (मजबूर करना), Pressure (दबाव डालना), Intimidate (डराना)

 

4. Dubious (संदिग्ध): Doubtful (संदेहपूर्ण), Questionable (संदिग्ध), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Suspect (शक के दायरे में)

 

5. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Fleeting (अल्पकालिक), Transient (क्षणभंगुर), Momentary (क्षणिक), Short-lived (अल्पजीवी)

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Obliterate
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Destroy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obliterate" means to destroy something completely, leaving no trace of it. Its closest synonym among the options is "Destroy" (to ruin or demolish completely). (नष्ट कर देना, मिटा देना)
◦ Example: The massive flood threatened to obliterate (destroy) the entire village within hours.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Create" means to bring something into existence — the direct opposite of obliterate, which erases something completely.

 

• Option 3 "Preserve" means to keep something safe and intact — the opposite of obliterate, which wipes something out.

 

• Option 4 "Repair" means to fix or restore something that is damaged — the reverse of obliterate, which destroys beyond restoration.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of obliterate: destroy, annihilate, eradicate, erase, demolish, wipe out. Antonyms: create, preserve, restore, build.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Furtive (गुप्त, चोरी-छिपे): Secretive (गुप्त), Stealthy (चुपके से किया गया), Sly (धूर्त), Covert (गुप्त)

 

2. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Sociable (मिलनसार), Outgoing (मिलनसार), Friendly (मित्रवत), Convivial (खुशमिज़ाज)

 

3. Hackneyed (घिसा-पिटा): Clichéd (घिसा-पिटा), Overused (अत्यधिक प्रयुक्त), Trite (साधारण), Stale (पुराना)

 

4. Impervious (अभेद्य): Impenetrable (अभेद्य), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी), Unaffected (अप्रभावित), Impregnable (दुर्भेद्य)

 

5. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Sound (युक्तिसंगत)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Relinquish
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Abandon.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Relinquish" means to give up or let go of something, especially a right, position, or possession. Its closest synonym among the options is "Abandon" (to leave or give up entirely). (त्याग देना, छोड़ देना)
◦ Example: The king was forced to relinquish (abandon) his throne after the rebellion.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Retain" means to keep or continue to have something — the opposite of giving something up, unlike relinquish.

 

• Option 2 "Acquire" means to gain or obtain something — the opposite process of relinquishing, which is giving something away.

 

• Option 3 "Sustain" means to keep something going or support it over time — the reverse of letting go, unlike relinquish.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of relinquish: abandon, surrender, forgo, renounce, cede, waive. Antonyms: retain, keep, acquire, maintain.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Alacrity (चपलता, उत्साह): Eagerness (उत्सुकता), Enthusiasm (उत्साह), Readiness (तत्परता), Promptness (शीघ्रता)

 

2. Austere (कठोर, सादा): Severe (कठोर), Strict (सख्त), Simple (सादा), Stern (कठोर स्वभाव का)

 

3. Belligerent (युद्धप्रिय, आक्रामक): Aggressive (आक्रामक), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Combative (लड़ाकू), Pugnacious (झगड़ालू)

 

4. Cajole (फुसलाना): Coax (मनाना), Persuade (राज़ी करना), Wheedle (चापलूसी से मनाना), Entice (लुभाना)

 

5. Debacle (विनाशकारी हार, तबाही): Disaster (विपत्ति), Failure (असफलता), Collapse (पतन), Fiasco (असफलता)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The recalcitrant student refused to follow the teacher's instructions even after repeated warnings.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Disobedient.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Recalcitrant" means stubbornly resistant to authority or control. Its closest synonym is "Disobedient". (हठी, अवज्ञाकारी)
◦ Correct: The recalcitrant (disobedient) student refused to follow the teacher's instructions even after repeated warnings.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2 "Compliant" (obedient), Option 3 "Docile" (easily managed) and Option 4 "Amenable" (agreeable) are unrelated to a stubborn refusal to obey authority.

 

NOTE

 

• "Recalcitrant" is most often met in the phrase "remain recalcitrant" — refusing to comply despite pressure. Synonyms: defiant, disobedient, obstinate, unruly, intractable. Antonyms: compliant, docile, obedient, amenable.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Laconic (कम बोलने वाला, संक्षिप्त): Terse (संक्षिप्त), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Concise (संक्षिप्त), Succinct (सारगर्भित)

 

2. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म, बारीकी से ध्यान देने वाला): Careful (सावधान), Precise (सटीक), Thorough (सम्पूर्ण), Painstaking (परिश्रमी)

 

3. Nostalgic (भूतकाल की याद में डूबा): Wistful (विषादपूर्ण), Sentimental (भावुक), Reminiscent (स्मरणकारी), Longing (लालसा से भरा)

 

4. Opulent (समृद्ध, विलासितापूर्ण): Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Lavish (भव्य), Affluent (संपन्न), Sumptuous (शानदार)

 

5. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Sensible (समझदार), Rational (तर्कसंगत)
